findings.text: 5 SOW milestones overdue since 2026-07-31: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all unconfirmed live.
Meta drove all 12 28-day leads at $53.47 CPL ($641.67 spend); Google spent $1,707.77 for 7 conversions at ~$243.97 CPL — 4.6x worse per lead.
3-day lead signal (Sep 8–10: 2+1+4=7 leads) vs prior 3 days (Sep 5–7: 1+1+1=3 leads) — accelerating, driven by Meta spend holding ~$57–73/day.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 for Sep 7–10 (4 consecutive zero days) after averaging 4.3/day Aug 14–Sep 6 — cause unknown, possible listing issue.
GHL shows 141 contacts and 59 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — leads arriving but no signed cases; intake pipeline may not be functioning.

suggestions.text: Shift $15/day from Google LSA toward Meta; Google CPL is 4.6x higher on confirmed 28-day data.
suggestions.monday_update: Move $15/day of daily budget from the Google LocalServicesCampaign to Meta, reducing Google daily pacing by roughly 13% while raising Meta. Meta is producing leads at $53.47 CPL vs Google's ~$243.97 CPL over the 28-day window, and the 3-day lead signal (7 leads Sep 8–10 vs 3 leads Sep 5–7) confirms Meta momentum. Success check: Meta CPL stays below $100 and lead volume holds at 3+ per week by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing: 4 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 7–10) vs prior 4.3/day average — restore or escalate.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions have been zero for 4 straight days (Sep 7–10) after averaging 4.3 actions/day for the prior 24 days. Check Google Business Profile for suspension, ownership issues, or policy flags and resolve immediately. Success check: GBP actions return to at least 3/day by 2026-09-18.

suggestions.text: Audit GHL intake: 59 opportunities created, 0 appointments, 0 signed cases — routing or follow-up cadence is broken.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 141 contacts and 59 opportunities but zero appointments booked and zero cases won — leads are entering but not converting, which is an intake failure, not an ads problem. Success check: at least 5 appointments booked within 7 days of this action, confirmed in GHL by 2026-09-18.
